name: shipster
description: Run a fleet of coding agents from Claude: see what needs you, file a goal, hear the plan, start the build, and unblock an agent that is waiting on you.

api_token.title: Shipster connector token
api_token.description: Create one in the Shipster dashboard under Settings > Claude connector. It starts with ast_. Tick "Can create and start goals" and "Can message agents" there if you want Claude to do those things; without them the token only reads.
